title: Correct U1 expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be U1 = (2 d^2 m v0^2) / (q L^2) or equivalent.

title: Correct U2 expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2a) must be U2 = (k R d^2 v0) / (q L) or equivalent.

title: Correct collection percentage
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be 25%.

title: Horizontal motion timing
description: Important: Uses the horizontal travel time t = L / v0 correctly in all parts.

title: Force balance with drag
description: Important: For part (2), correctly sets the electric force qU2/d equal to the drag force k R v_max at terminal velocity.

title: Vertical displacement relation
description: Important: Relates the vertical displacement needed for collection (d or d') to the vertical velocity and time (d = v_max * t).

title: Charge-radius proportionality
description: Important: For part (3), correctly applies that charge is proportional to radius squared, leading to q' = q/16 for the smaller particle.

title: Kinematics for no drag
description: Optional: For part (1), correctly uses constant acceleration kinematics (d = 1/2 a t^2) and Newton's second law (qE = ma).

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error with the negative charge or incorrectly substitutes units (e.g., diameter vs. radius).

title: Confusing acceleration regimes
description: Pitfall: For part (2), fails to use the terminal velocity condition or incorrectly applies kinematics for accelerated motion.
